packageRules.description: Camel, and everything version-paired with it (Quarkus, Spring Boot/Framework, CXF, langchain4j), is bumped manually alongside camel.version as part of the Camel-version alignment process — see CLAUDE.md's Branching and Versioning Strategy

camel-latest is reset to main's tree on every Camel release, so routine bumps there would be overwritten: they wait for approval on the Dependency Dashboard. Security fixes still open PRs right away, because vulnerability rules force dependencyDashboardApproval off.
